messages.subject: Energy & Natural Resources Leadership | Mining, ESG, Government Relations and Country Strategy
messages.body:
Dear Cripps Leadership Advisors Team,

I am introducing my profile for senior leadership mandates across mining, metals, energy, infrastructure and natural resources. Cripps' global Energy & Natural Resources practice, including executive search across mining, metal processing, energy transition and industrial transformation, is closely aligned with my background.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG and sustainability, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy, executive advisory and cross-functional execution within a major multinational gold-mining operation.

My strongest value is at the intersection of international investment, regulation, stakeholder trust, licence to operate and operating execution. I also support the institutional interface around a large industrial solar and battery-storage programme, adding practical exposure to energy transition and infrastructure delivery.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE, while I remain open to international resources jurisdictions. I would welcome confidential consideration for Director, Senior Director, Country Director or Representative, External or Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across mining, metals, energy, industrial and infrastructure organisations.

My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
